authority.description: authority is the address that controls the module (defaults to x/gov unless overwritten).

params.description: params defines the x/nameservice parameters to update. NOTE: All parameters must be supplied, except reserved_names which is optional. If reserved_names is blank, the existing value will be preserved.

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgUpdatePa.title: Msg Update Params
dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgUpdatePa.description: MsgUpdateParams is the Msg/UpdateParams request type.

mint_fee_per_coin.description: mint_fee_per_coin defines the fee in udys charged per coin minted

min_bid_timeout_class.description: Bounds for per-class bidding parameters Class bid_timeout must be within [min_bid_timeout_class, max_bid_timeout_class]

min_reject_bid_valuation_fee_percent.description: Class reject fee percent must be within [min_reject_bid_valuation_fee_percent, max_reject_bid_valuation_fee_percent]

min_minimum_bid_percent_increase.description: Class minimum bid percent increase must be within [min_minimum_bid_percent_increase, max_minimum_bid_percent_increase]

min_valuation_fee_pct.description: Class valuation fee percent must be within [min_valuation_fee_pct, max_valuation_fee_pct]

min_valuation_period.description: Class valuation period bounds must be within [min_valuation_period, max_valuation_period]

reserved_names.description: reserved_names defines a newline-separated list of forbidden .dys names that cannot be registered via the normal commit-reveal process. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Reserved names can still be created via CreateExternalName (governance only). If this field is blank in MsgUpdateParams, the existing value is preserved and not updated.

name_suffix.description: name_suffix is the suffix for all registered names (e.g., ".dys"). This is set at genesis and should NOT be changed after chain launch. All names must end with this suffix (e.g., "alice.dys", "myapp.dys").

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.Params.title: Params
dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the nameservice module.

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgUpdatePa.title: Msg Update Params Response
dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgUpdatePa.description: MsgUpdateParamsResponse defines the response structure for executing a MsgUpdateParams message.
